canonical_name: Futures for All Work Experience Programme

age_range.verbatim: open to 14 to 19-year-olds in state schools and colleges across the country

prerequisites: Must be in a UK state school or college. Registration is free at account.futuresforall.org/registration; opportunities are browsed via the Work Experience Finder.
duration: Flexible: half-day, full-day and multi-day options, plus shorter 'Insight Days'
cost_note: Described as a fully funded programme; no cost to students or educators.
selection_process: Placement-by-placement application through the Work Experience Finder; the page does not describe a competitive selection process.
award_or_output: Work experience placement — in-person at an employer site, remote/online interactive sessions, or hybrid.
source_title: About Our Work Experience Programme | Futures for All

sources.supports: 14–19 age range, UK state school/college requirement, fully funded, formats and durations, registration URLs

research_notes: VERIFIED: age range, the UK state-school eligibility restriction, the fully-funded status, the delivery formats, and the registration route — all from the organizer's own page. RENAME EVIDENCE: https://www.speakersforschools.org/experience-2/work-experience/ returns HTTP 301 to https://www.futuresforall.org/... — strong evidence that Speakers for Schools work experience now operates as Futures for All. The Futures for All page still references 'Speakers for Schools' as a programme area under its umbrella, so the exact corporate relationship (full rebrand vs parent brand) is NOT verified and is flagged rather than asserted. HIGH DEDUP RISK: if ORYN already holds a 'Speakers for Schools' row, this is the same opportunity under a new name — the ingestion lane should merge, not add. NOT VERIFIED: deadlines (placements are posted on a rolling basis), employer list, and whether privately-educated or home-schooled students are excluded in practice. GEOGRAPHY CAVEAT: UK-only and state-school-only, so this does not serve ORYN's Turkish or international students at all — it is recorded because the internship category has only 8 rows and this is one of the largest genuinely free secondary-school work-experience schemes that exists.

deadline: 2026-04 (month only; official page states applications close April 2026 and are now closed)

cost_note: Verbatim: 'In2STEM is entirely free to join, and we provide a bursary to cover travel and lunch expenses during placements!'
financial_aid: Bursary covering travel and lunch expenses during placements
award_or_output: In-person STEM work experience placement, plus online skills/employability/careers workshops and public engagement competitions.

research_notes: VERIFIED for the 2026 cycle: programme dates (20 July–21 August 2026), the free-plus-bursary funding, the Year 12 / S5–S6 eligibility, and that the 2026 application window (Dec 2025–April 2026) has closed. The 2026 programme has in fact already finished as of today (2026-08-21). NOT VERIFIED: exact application close date (only the month 'April 2026' is published), the widening-participation/household-income criteria that In2scienceUK is known to apply (the page fetched says only 'Year 12 or S5/S6 students passionate about STEM' — the eligibility subpage was not fetched, so any income criterion is UNKNOWN and must not be asserted), and 2027 cycle dates, which are not published. Recorded as an internship because the organizer frames it as 'work experience placements', but it is functionally a research-exposure placement and would also serve ORYN's thin research category. GEOGRAPHY CAVEAT: UK-only, commutable-distance placements — not usable by international students.
